notes.title: NEW UPDATES 1.1 COUNTY HOSPITAL
notes.content:
[b]UPDATES 15/08/21[/b]
[i]County Hospital[/i]

[i]
[b]We are happy to announce the new updates and fixes:[/b][/i]

[list]
[*] OPTIMIZATION for all kind of PC and VideoCards NEW GRAPHICS MENU
 - This is something that all our buyers ask for... now you have 3 options in the main menu, LOW graphics, MED graphics and HIGH graphics, so now you can enjoy it in any kind of computer specs

[*] ZOMBIE BUG FIXED
- All bugs on Mr. Zombie are fixed... now its more fast... more intelligent... you better run... or hide.... we made a surprise for you near to the end

[*] NEW PLACEMENT OF KEYS AND NEW CLUES
- The hospital its not the same... you must find the new clues and keys, no more like yesterday... enjoy this game again if you play it already... (old youtube gameplay videos will not help, now its your turn)

[*] NEW MUSIC and Fixed Sound
- We fix some audios and make more new music for this horror game

[*] NEW JUMPSCARES
- There are so many new things in the game... please if you played it already play it again! if not... enjoy!!!
[/list]

[url=https://drive.google.com/file/d/1UKAgFZW1wCmWhnL69kTJjGdD2VCRiBI7/view?usp=sharing]SCREENSHOT[/url]

[h3]We are a single solo dev man in a dream LFR games its our starter company
All the nice reviews and gameplays are very welcome !!! Recommend this game to your friends!
THANKS FOR PLAYING!!!
[/h3]
